verdict.rationale: Founder Law is a U.S. immigration and startup law firm that sells flat-fee, attorney-managed legal packages, not a software product. Asking whether it ships an official CLI is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no CLI or programmatic interface: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path, and an llms.txt file alone does not make a CLI axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
